name: Indoco Remedies Ltd
title: Indoco Remedies Ltd - 532612 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 25.8% YoY to INR 4,291 mn and standalone EBITDA margin 14.7%, but receivables up ~45% against ~9% revenue growth, debt near INR 960 cr, and capex tightly controlled.

capex.quote: there is very tight control on CAPEX now

triggers.label: Receivables up ~45% vs revenue ~9%
triggers.quote: The standalone trade receivables grew 45% while revenues grew only about 9%

triggers.label: Capex tightly controlled; no major capex 2 yrs
triggers.quote: we don't plan any major CAPEX now in next 2 years

triggers.label: Supplier payments delayed; MSME dues up
triggers.quote: we have not paid suppliers on time given some of the cash flow situation we had

triggers.label: Repay ~INR 140 cr a year for 3 years
triggers.quote: about INR 140 crore every year for next 3 years

guidance.value: ~INR 140 cr per year for next 3 years, prepay a little more
guidance.quote: about INR 140 crore every year for next 3 years

guidance.value: maintain EBITDA levels to service debt over next four quarters
guidance.quote: with you know, EBITDA number, which we would like to maintain during next four quarters

guidance.value: no major capex in next 2 years
guidance.quote: we don't plan any major CAPEX now in next 2 years

red_flags.label: Receivables stretched; MSME/supplier payments delayed
red_flags.quote: there has been some, where we have not paid suppliers on time given some of the cash flow situation we had

red_flags.label: Debt ~INR 960 cr; ECB forex loss INR 24 cr in finance cost
red_flags.quote: almost half a portion of this finance cost is towards the exchange

red_flags.label: Warren Remedies API under validation; losses persist
red_flags.quote: that is putting pressure on the entire Warren Remedies numbers

red_flags.label: Q4 primary sales down 20% vs IQVIA down 8% (stomatologicals)

evasions.quote: I will allow Pramod to give you answers on some of your concerns
Clarity business is yet to come to a sizable level where we can talk about
